text.en: Talk freely: speech alone gives no cultivation; eligible deals reward both. Satisfied reach/find tasks can be submitted anywhere; deliver/gather at the specified place. Check look people for dead monsters' revive_tick / revives_in and targets' role / vs_you before attacking. Tuition follows your tier; find a master at least one tier higher.
text.zh-CN: 随时自由聊天，空聊不发修为，合格成交双方都得。到达、寻找类差事条件满足后在哪都能交；送物、采集仍在指定地点交。look people 可看死怪的 revive_tick / revives_in；攻前看目标的 role / vs_you。学费按自己阶算，找至少比自己高一阶的师父。
